result.title: RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks
result.summary: Real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks require agents to understand repository structures, cross-module dependencies, and runtime behaviors, posing significant challenges for constructing high-quality training and evaluation data. To address this, we propose RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent task synthesis. Starting from 8,477 open-source repositories and approximately 2.48 million pull request records, we employ semantic alignment, complexity constraints, and multidimensional quality assessment to identify valuable SWE data. We further develop a sandbox-based multi-agent framework that integrates automated environment construction, execution validation, repository exploration, and evidence-grounded Q&A synthesis. Based on this framework, we construct RepoEviQA, a benchmark for Repository-Level Evidence-Grounded Question Answering, comprising 334 tasks across five programming languages and diverse SWE categories, with rigorous rubric-based evaluation. We evaluate five frontier coding models on RepoEviQA, revealing substantial performance differences across task categories and programming languages.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RepoEviAgent，一个面向软件仓库的可扩展数据构建框架，将质量感知的数据筛选与角色分工的多智能体任务合成（含自动环境搭建、执行验证、仓库探索与带证据的问答生成）结合，并据此构建含 334 个任务、覆盖五种语言的 RepoEviQA 基准，评测了五个前沿代码模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「带证据问答」的合成流程与基于量规的评测，可能为 LVR 中如何构造并验证「答案确实使用证据」的推理轨迹提供线索；但该工作仅限代码文本，无视觉输入与 latent 状态，需人工核查可迁移性。
